title: Kiosk Availability Guarantees and Service Credit Rates by Micro Market Format
content:
Each Unattended Micro Market Program format guarantees a level of kiosk availability as a percentage of opening hours, earns a percentage of the settlement for each hour of kiosk outage, holds the credits allowed in one settlement period to a ceiling, and allows a claim only inside a printed claim window.

| Market format | Availability guaranteed, per cent of opening hours | Credit per outage hour, per cent of settlement | Ceiling on credits in one settlement period, per cent of settlement | Claim window, calendar days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cooler & Snack Wall | 95 | 0.5 | 10 | 14 |
| Compact Micro Market | 96 | 0.75 | 15 | 14 |
| Standard Micro Market | 97.5 | 1 | 20 | 21 |
| Fresh Food Micro Market | 98 | 1.5 | 25 | 30 |
| Expanded Campus Micro Market | 99 | 2 | 30 | 30 |
| Smart Store Micro Market | 99.5 | 1.75 | 25 | 21 |

## Points of judgement

The availability guarantee rises without exception across the formats, from 95 per cent on the Cooler & Snack Wall to 99.5 per cent on the Smart Store Micro Market. The credit earned for each outage hour does not follow it in every column: the Expanded Campus Micro Market earns the highest rate at 2 per cent of the settlement, while the Smart Store Micro Market, with the highest guarantee, earns 1.75 per cent.

The ceiling on the credits allowed in one settlement period is 10 per cent of that settlement on the Cooler & Snack Wall, 15 on the Compact Micro Market, 20 on the Standard Micro Market, 25 on both the Fresh Food Micro Market and the Smart Store Micro Market, and 30 on the Expanded Campus Micro Market. The claim window is 14 calendar days on the two smallest formats, 21 on the Standard Micro Market and the Smart Store Micro Market, and 30 on the other two.
